name: cloud9
description: Cloud9(https://github.com/c9/core) Cloud9 is a complete web based IDE with terminal access. This container is for running their core SDK locally and developing plugins.

paths.name: Path: /code
paths.description: Optionally if you want to mount up a local folder of code instead of checking out

paths.name: Path: /var/run/docker.sock
paths.description: Needed if you plan to use Docker or compose commands

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: The port for the Cloud9 web interface

variables.name: GITURL
variables.description: Specify a git repo to checkout on first startup

variables.name: USERNAME
variables.description: Optionally specify a username for http auth

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.description: Optionally specify a password for http auth (if USERNAME and PASSWORD are not set, there will be no http auth)
